seed_factors.name: Previously researched price momentum
seed_factors.definition: Trailing positive price momentum as recorded in prior fixed ETF research.
seed_factors.rationale: Preserve the already studied momentum family rather than recount it as a new discovery.
seed_factors.limitations: Prior results do not establish future alpha; ETF timing is not individual-stock evidence.

seed_factors.name: Previously researched value exposure
seed_factors.definition: Value characteristics accessed through the actual VLUE ETF in the earlier research.
seed_factors.rationale: Retain value as a distinct economic family without inventing direct historical stock scores.
seed_factors.limitations: ETF exposure is not complete point-in-time constituent data.

seed_factors.name: Previously researched quality exposure
seed_factors.definition: Issuer-described profitability, stable earnings and low debt exposure through QUAL.
seed_factors.rationale: Cash-flow accrual quality belongs to this economic family, not a new independent family.
seed_factors.limitations: Related quality definitions may be highly correlated.

seed_factors.name: Previously researched low-volatility exposure
seed_factors.definition: Lower-volatility equity exposure through the actual USMV fund.
seed_factors.rationale: Preserve the prior risk-factor family without treating repeated windows as separate factors.
seed_factors.limitations: No guaranteed drawdown ceiling or independent alpha.

discovery_policy: Discover economically motivated definitions, not a grid of moving-average values. Every new definition, failed trial and data blocker remains recorded. Proposals are not counted as evaluated strategies.
source_policy: Verify paper/issuer definitions and licenses. Only actual point-in-time inputs may support a strategy test. Current provider extraction, a two-company sample or a current stock list is not full historical evidence.
publication_policy: Only explicit audited source/configuration/sanitized evidence commits. No raw prices, filings, broker state, credentials, broad git add or force pushes.
existing_forward_ledgers: Remain paused and unchanged. This program never reads, resets or resumes them.
